## The iCloud Access Problem — Root Cause & Solution

**Why login keeps being required:** iCloud Drive does not have a public API. The only way to access files in it programmatically is through a web browser session. Apple's iCloud web login uses two-factor authentication and session cookies that expire — meaning every new browser session requires a fresh login. This is Apple's security design and cannot be bypassed.

**The seamless solution — two parts:**

### Part 1: One-time login in Your Browser (required once, then persistent)

Your own local Chrome browser ("My Browser") stores cookies that persist across sessions — unlike the sandbox browser, which resets. **If you log into iCloud.com once in your own Chrome browser, that session stays active for weeks to months** (Apple's "Keep me signed in" option). After that, every automated run will use your already-authenticated browser session without any login prompt.

To do this right now: open Chrome on your computer, go to [icloud.com](https://www.icloud.com), sign in with your Apple ID, and check "Keep me signed in." That's the only time you'll ever need to do it.

### Part 2: Automated recurring check (runs without you)

Once the login is persistent in your browser, I will set up a **scheduled task that runs automatically** — checking the Recordings Vault Inbox on a schedule you choose (e.g., every morning, or a few times a day), transcribing any new audio files, creating summaries, naming them by topic and date, and sorting them into the correct Notion folder. You will never need to manually trigger it.

---

**What I need from you to complete the setup:**

1. **Log into iCloud.com once in your Chrome browser** (the one connected as "My Browser") and check "Keep me signed in" — this is the only manual step, ever.
2. **Tell me your preferred check schedule** — e.g., "every morning at 8am," "twice a day," "every few hours," etc.

Once you confirm the login is done and give me a schedule preference, I will finalize the automation and it will run completely on its own going forward.
